normalization.hyphens: word boundary, reversible to original display token
normalization.punctuation: excluded from alignment words, retained unchanged in display captions
normalization.digits: only explicit beat-local display aliases; never globally expand or replace numbers
normalization.audio_clock: full unchanged WAV; add only scene narration offset0.3s, never add speech_start_seconds again

acceptance_proposal.identity: Alignment must name the exact clip ID, audio SHA256, text SHA256 and model revision; preserve raw aligned word intervals/scores and any alignment flags.
acceptance_proposal.transcript: All canonical words must match monotonically and exactly once with finite ordered timestamps inside the actual WAV duration; no silent omission, repeated-word ambiguity, invented word or transcript rewriting.
acceptance_proposal.confidence: Treat CTC scores as diagnostics, not calibrated correctness probabilities. Flag low-scoring words, pathological durations and large intra-clause gaps for listening; do not accept a focus anchor from uncertain alignment merely because the whole clip passed.
acceptance_proposal.caption_start: Map each unchanged caption to its first canonical word start plus narration offset, optionally at most0.06s early within the preceding gap.
acceptance_proposal.caption_end: End at the next mapped caption start, or last spoken word end plus at most0.12s when a longer pause warrants a gap; never overlap captions or exceed the scene. Preserve all atomic alias spans and two-line pixel fit.
acceptance_proposal.focus: Map the exact unique spoken anchor span into scene time, then intersect desired lead/hold with both the current approved observed-edit window and the original source-visible window under the unchanged source segments. All zoom easing and outline frames must remain within one continuously visible geometric interval.
acceptance_proposal.focus_conflict: If the semantic anchor is outside the actual visibility interval, flag it for review; do not silently clamp it elsewhere, move source cuts, extend a box across a cut/scroll or label proportional fallback as aligned.
acceptance_proposal.focus_dwell: Use a restrained lead of approximately0.2–0.3s and follow-through of0.4–0.7s when permitted by visibility. Prefer1.8–3.5s; short narrow windows may use outline-only. Never force minimum dwell by crossing visibility boundaries.
acceptance_proposal.exceptions: Beat30 remains the approved external architecture overlay only. Beat36 remains outline-only inside its short actual Import hold. Chat04/06 focus awaits the new actual recording;04audio can be aligned independently.
acceptance_proposal.fallback: Keep the currently verified video/plan unchanged until the actual alignment and sampled audio/visual review are accepted. No source cuts, speech text, WAV bytes or product state are changed by this mapping.
